palette.notes: Code: 17 colours, 2 ramps, median hue shift 18.9 deg. Pink hero (pale pink body, hot-pink mane, magenta outline) on cream, sky blue and soft green; one grey-teal flashback scene.

lighting: Flat, soft; blush dots on cheeks instead of shading; mane has one darker pink band.
silhouette: Chibi pony with an oversized curly mane, big head; reads as a pink blob with ears even small. Close-ups show a waving bust.

motion.timing: Code (first 20 s): median hold 50 ms (p25 33.3, p75 66.7), on 1.5s, 17.44 changes/s; mixed ones and twos with held poses on the planet scenes.

texture: Clean outlines in coloured (dark pink) line, almost no dither (0.0003); pixel title text 'Smile', 'Pixel Animation'.
camera: Static frames per scene; hard cuts between vignettes: title card, bust close-up, balloon circle, tiny planet, grey flashback, legs-only shot.

acting.enters: Trots in front of a title card; pops up into frame for a wave.
acting.acts: Walks, waves, holds balloons, stands on a small planet; the grey flashback shows her flat mane.
acting.exits: Cuts; one shot shows only her legs as she bounces out of frame.
acting.depth: Close bust shots alternate with her small on a planet; a second pony peeks in from the frame edge.

techniques: legs-only shot: crop the character to show an exit or jump
same set revisited (balloons, planet) for a loop structure
character peeks in from frame edge
desaturated scene for a mood flashback
blush dots instead of face shading
feel: soft pastel bg + pink coloured outlines + chibi trot on 1s/2s + revisited vignettes = sweet looping charm
for_fred: Revisit the same 2-3 sets: Fred appears close (bust wave), then small on a planet, then only his tail at the frame edge as he leaves, then peeks back in. Use a dark-orange outline on Fred instead of black.
